additions.description: The DELETE /todos/{id} endpoint returns a JSON message {'message': 'Todo deleted'} on success
additions.reasoning: The specification requires DELETE /todos/{id} to return 200 OK but does not specify any response body. The code returns a JSON message which is an addition.

omissions.description: POST /todos does not validate that the 'title' field is present and non-empty, and does not return 400 Bad Request with validation error if missing or empty
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires that POST /todos with empty or missing title returns 400 Bad Request with validation error 'The Title field is required.' The code does not perform such validation and will accept empty or missing titles.

omissions.description: PUT /todos/{id} does not reject requests where the id in the request body differs from the id in the URL, returning 400 Bad Request
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires that if the id in the PUT request body differs from the URL id, the response is 400 Bad Request. The code ignores the id field in the body and does not perform this check.

omissions.description: PUT /todos/{id} does not return 404 Not Found if the todo with the given id does not exist
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires 404 Not Found if the todo to update does not exist. The code does return 404 in this case, so no omission here.

omissions.description: GET /todos/{id} returns 404 Not Found if the todo does not exist or does not belong to the current user
omissions.reasoning: The code correctly returns 404 in these cases, so no omission.

omissions.description: DELETE /todos/{id} returns 404 Not Found if the todo does not exist or does not belong to the current user
omissions.reasoning: The code correctly returns 404 in these cases, so no omission.

omissions.description: GET /todos without Authorization header returns 401 Unauthorized
omissions.reasoning: The code raises 401 Unauthorized if no credentials are provided, fulfilling this requirement.

omissions.description: POST /users/register returns 200 OK on successful registration
omissions.reasoning: The code returns 200 OK with user data on successful registration, fulfilling this requirement.

omissions.description: POST /users/login returns a token on successful login
omissions.reasoning: The code returns a token on successful login, fulfilling this requirement.

omissions.description: POST /todos does not check for empty or missing title and does not return 400 Bad Request with validation error
omissions.reasoning: The specification explicitly requires validation and error response for missing or empty title, but the code does not implement this.

omissions.description: PUT /todos/{id} does not check that the id in the request body matches the URL id and does not return 400 Bad Request if they differ
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires this validation, but the code ignores the id in the request body.
